label: Town of Underhill
header:
# Town of Underhill municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 24; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Patricia Richards, Maureen Collins-Kolb, Daniel Steinbauer, Robert Stone, and Shara Tarule for Underhill's five-member board
Town of Underhill, Selectboard page (underhillvt.gov): Patricia Richards (Chair), Maureen Collins-Kolb (Vice-Chair), Dan Steinbauer, Robert Stone, and Shara Tarule
Town of Underhill, official ballot return of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Patricia Richards won the three-year seat (548) and Shara Tarule the two-year seat (530)

Town of Underhill, FY2025 Town Report, abstract of the annual town meeting of March 4, 2025: Robert Stone won a three-year seat (484), Maureen Collins-Kolb a two-year seat (455), and Shara Tarule a one-year seat (227) in 2025
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Town of Underhill, official ballot return of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Sherri Morin won the Town Clerk seat (620) for a three-year term
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Sherri Morin as Underhill's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Sherri Morin as Underhill's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 155 (Town of Underhill): section 22: the town shall not elect other collectors of current or delinquent taxes -- the Treasurer collects, and no collector of delinquent taxes post is created

Town of Underhill, FY2025 Town Report, abstract of the annual town meeting of March 4, 2025: Sherri Morin won the Treasurer seat (511) for a three-year term in 2025; the clerk and treasurer offices run on staggered three-year cycles and she holds both
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Sherri Morin as Underhill's Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Sherri Morin as Underhill's Town Treasurer
Town of Underhill, Official Warning for the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website): Article 1 elects a Moderator from the floor for the ensuing year

Town of Underhill, FY2025 Town Report, abstract of the annual town meeting of March 4, 2025: Dan Manz was elected Moderator in 2025; the 2026 floor outcome is not published, so the post is created without a membership
